title: Supply Chain Logistics Optimization
description: End-to-end SQL project analyzing logistics orders, route costs, carrier choices, warehouse constraints, and optimization opportunities.
metric: Optimized $25.9M Supply Chain Network Costs, Identified $58K Cost Saving Opportunity Across 15,398 Orders
insights: Detected carrier allocation inefficiencies driving excess freight costs
Found that a small number of routes contributed disproportionately to logistics expenses
Revealed operational efficiency differences across warehouse regions
